lines.en: I drift. My steps make no sound.
I pass through a whole wall.
The air chills behind me.
I've no shadow to walk on.
I float up out of the dark.
I drift toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我飘过走廊，轮廓一直抖。
lines.en: I drift down the hall, my outline always trembling.
No feet — only a blur.
Dust swirls up in my wake.
I drift past a dead lamp.
I touch nothing as I move.
I'm heading your way.
There were other names here once.
My voice sounds broken.
Waiting to be remembered.
The shadow on the wall isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我的头转过来，身子没动。
lines.en: My head turns while my body stays.
The air cools around me.
I feel nothing.
My being isn't very stable.
I just hang here.

lines.zh: 墙上的裂缝，我数到第九道。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the wall up to the ninth.
You can actually see me?

lines.zh: 屋里这么静，你的呼吸很响。
lines.en: The house is so quiet, your breathing is loud.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，也谈不上好意。
lines.en: I mean no harm. Nor any good.

lines.zh: 灯灭之后，我就在这儿了。
lines.en: I have been here since the lights went out.
The door behind you is shut.
Do you remember this name?
Your shadow moves faster than you.
I'm closer than you think.
Don't try to talk to me.

lines.zh: 你的光只能照亮很小一块。
lines.en: Your light reaches very little.
The spot you're standing on is cold.

lines.zh: 这栋房子的地板，我认得你的脚步。
lines.en: I know your footsteps on this house's floor.

lines.zh: 灯举得再高，也穿不过我。
lines.en: Raise the lamp high; it still passes through me.
My soul's shape scatters for a moment.
I lost the sense of pain long ago.
I've retreated halfway into the wall.
My outline has gone faint.

lines.zh: 这一下碰到了我的核心。
lines.en: That touched my very core.
I'm still here, fainter.
My voice cut out for a moment.

lines.zh: 我飘着，没有脚步声地聚回来。
lines.en: I drift back together without a footstep.
This form won't last long.
I still remember that name.

lines.zh: 冷饭摆在桌上，我碰不了。
lines.en: Cold food sits on the table; I cannot touch it.
That's no use to a spirit.
My name is nothing but garbled code.
I've no mouth to bite with.

lines.zh: 我连食物的味道都忘了。
lines.en: I have forgotten even the smell of food.
What you hold is warm.
I can't pick it up.
I'm not hungry. Just empty.
Keep it. You still need it.

lines.zh: 你们活着的人才需要这些。
lines.en: Only the living need such things.
You just passed through me.
It's colder on my side.
Don't walk so close to that wall.
There's nothing of me to bump.
You pass through me, teeth chattering.
I've moved aside a little.
The air moves through me.
We overlapped for a moment.
Can you feel me?
Your arm's gone numb.
I'm not that person anymore.
This form is empty.
I'm only a residue.
Don't ask me that.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里，只剩我们两个。
lines.en: In this house only the two of us remain.

lines.zh: 我只是剩下来的一点回声。
lines.en: I'm only a leftover echo.
I drifted slowly away.

lines.zh: 这个问题对我没有意义。
lines.en: That question means nothing to me.
All I have left is an echo.
I turned and passed through the wall.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I reach out and grasp nothing.
I can't lift it at all.
It reminds me of something.
This isn't yours, is it.

lines.zh: 它躺在地上，我只能看着。
lines.en: It lies on the floor; all I can do is look.
It fell. So light.
I tried to touch it.

lines.zh: 手指穿过去，什么也没抓住。
lines.en: My fingers pass through and grasp nothing.

lines.zh: 我碰不到它，就留给你吧。
lines.en: I cannot touch it, so it stays for you.
You touched it, and now it is cold too.
You're the only one in this room.
I saw you when you moved.
That door is locked. You can't leave.
The light doesn't reach between us.
Position locked, running is useless.

lines.zh: 我一直等你抬头，等到现在。
lines.en: I waited for you to look up — until now.
I've closed this room.
Will you listen to me?
My shape is changing.
Someone knocked three times inside the wall.
I've drifted forward a little.
There is dust in the corner, and me.
I'm on this side of the wall.
No one's coming this time.

lines.zh: 门轴响了一声，我穿了过来。
lines.en: A hinge creaks and I pass through.
You're still in that spot.
The light keeps flickering.
I'm halfway through the wall.
You're panting in the corner.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一点一点挪近。
lines.en: I hug the wall and creep closer bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你身后的影子不是你的。
lines.en: The shadow behind you isn't yours.

lines.zh: 灵魂的形态，名字是乱码。
lines.en: A soul form with a scrambled name.

lines.zh: 你不退，我就再靠近一点。
lines.en: You do not back away, so I come closer.
Time isn't right here.
I lower my voice.
The room is smaller than before.
You hear me, so I'm here.
A soul's shadow slid around.
Everywhere you look is about the same.
One step more and I'm there.
You grip the door handle and your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 我离你的后颈，只剩一寸。
lines.en: Only an inch remains between me and your neck.
I'm starting to remember something.

lines.zh: 墙里的水管，忽然不响了。
lines.en: The pipes in the wall suddenly fall silent.
You've given up running.

lines.zh: 我的手伸进了你的胸口。
lines.en: My hand goes into your chest.
No pain. Only cold.
Your light dimmed for a moment.
I've caught hold of your breath.
You've been pushed back a step.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边吹了一口气。
lines.en: I breathe once beside your ear.
The room dropped in temperature.
I passed through your arm.

lines.zh: 你听到的是你自己的声音。
lines.en: That's your own voice you hear.
I've slipped back into the shadow.
I drift without touching the ground.
I've left nothing behind.
That was a reminder for you.
My shape scatters and re-forms.

lines.zh: 我的冷气，顺着你的领口进去。
lines.en: My cold seeps in through your collar.
I won't leave this room.
I float out through the wall.

lines.zh: 最后一盏灯，在我身边灭了。
lines.en: The last lamp dies beside me.
The air went cold all at once.
I can't say the right name.
Dust spins on the floor.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，只是没显形。
lines.en: I was always here, just unseen.
My outline is sharpening.
My memories break apart piece by piece.

lines.zh: 这间旧屋，比外面冷得多。
lines.en: This old house is far colder than outside.

lines.zh: 我又站起来了，虽然没有脚。
lines.en: I've stood up again, without feet.
There's a mark of me on the floor.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有脚步声，是新的。
lines.en: I hear steps far off; a new one.
I begin hunting that sound.
No outside light gets in.
I'm waiting in the corner.
It's getting colder around me.
The firelight made me nearly transparent.
I fall, and make no sound.

lines.zh: 水对我没有意义，却也压住我。
lines.en: Water means nothing to me, yet it weighs.
The blast scattered me apart.
It went straight through me.
That light tries to hold me.
I cannot even keep my name.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照得无处可躲。
lines.en: The flash leaves me nothing to hide behind.

lines.zh: 这里比我先前的住处还空。
lines.en: This place is emptier than where I was.
